answer: An agent economy can weight votes by collateral locked for 30 days, rather than by account count. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand identities still buys only 100 tokens of voting weight. Like water branching through karst, identities divide the same underlying resource. A spiral of fake accounts adds no power; to turn an ember of influence into control, an attacker must acquire and immobilize enough collateral to outweigh honest voters.
